title: Comment on “Testing quantum gravity using pulsed optomechanical systems”
description: Analytical Comment on Wilson-Gerow, Chen and Stamp, Phys. Rev. D 109, 064078 (2024). At the same position drive and detuning, the two exclusive photon probabilities in the first-swap rotating-wave CWL model coincide with those of the centered Schrödinger–Newton oscillator. A nonzero ordinary background limits the physical interpretation at finite pulse strength. AI-assisted preprint for author review. Includes manuscript, editable source, and reproducible arithmetic checks.
